name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_Ctor
summary: One-shot constructor of a 0x37C-byte field scene object: lazily allocates and zeroes the backing block, installs the vtable, sets 0xFF/0 defaults and constructs eight 8-byte sub-records at +0x2C.

name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseTalk
summary: Closes a talk session on a message window: finishes the talk transition on the shared talk handle, releases the window's line objects and invalidates the bound 2D field character.
evidence: Callees Text_ReleaseLineObjects, Ui_SmithMenu_FinishTransition on self->f_B0+0x146 and Field2D_OnCharacterChanged on self->f_88 fix the close-the-talk-window role; the 'Emote' wording is unsupported, so the name is corrected to a plain talk close.

name: Gfx_Sprite_Dtor
summary: Sprite destructor: installs the sprite vtable 0x007591FC and base vtable 0x0075D55C, destroys four 0x48-byte span entries, unlinks the intrusive node and frees the object.
evidence: Same destructor template as the named Actor2D_SpriteNode_DtorDeleteB; called from Ui_SpriteWidget_Ctor, Actor2D_SpriteNode_Ctor and Field_SpriteSceneObject_Create, so the sprite class role is supported even though the vtable owner is unnamed.

name: Ui_OverlaySlot_Dtor
summary: Overlay-slot widget destructor: installs the overlay-slot vtable and base vtable, destroys eight 0x48-byte span entries, unlinks the intrusive node and frees the object.
evidence: Body installs maybe_g_uiOverlaySlotVtable (the same table used by Ui_OverlaySlotCtor_vt1D71DC) and then g_gfxSprite2DVtable, with std_destroy_range stride 0x48 count 8 and Field_Object_DtorBase; the class is the overlay slot, not a generic widget.

name: Actor2D_SpriteNode_DtorC
summary: Actor2D sprite-node destructor: installs g_actor2DSpriteNodeClassDesc and the base vtable, destroys eight 0x48-byte span entries, unlinks the intrusive node and frees the object.
evidence: First vtable installed is g_actor2DSpriteNodeClassDesc, the same descriptor used by the named Actor2D_SpriteNode_Ctor (0x002907D8) and Actor2D_SpriteNode_DtorDeleteB; it sits right after that ctor.

name: Field_SceneObject_DeletingDtorA
summary: Deleting destructor of a field scene object: restores the embedded Actor2D node's vtable words, unlinks that node from its intrusive list, runs Field_Object_DtorBase on the embedded object and releases storage.
evidence: Writes 0x0075D55C and its +0x98 sub-table, unlinks via 0x0017C330, calls Field_Object_DtorBase at -0x24C and 0x0010F6CC; same template as the named Field_SceneObject_DeletingDtorD.

name: maybe_Ui_ItemScreen_HandleCount
summary: Item-screen quantity step: requires the page scroll to be finished, resolves the member record for the selected party slot, compares the current quantity with the member's owned count to decide whether the +/- step is legal, updates the number pane and returns the next handler pair.
evidence: Body is damaged (halt_baddata, unaff_r5/r6) but the member-slot bound 0x1F, quantity field +0xC, owned-count compare via 0x006293A8 and Ui_SetNumberTextPane1 are visible; no caller confirms the verb.

name: maybe_Ui_ItemScreen_BeginSelect
summary: Item-screen step handler: if the page scroll is finished it chains to the selection-result handler with the context flags cleared; otherwise it writes screen command 10, reactivates the screen and returns the default handler pair.
evidence: Same skeleton as the sibling step handlers and calls the still-unproven ShowSelectionResult; no direct caller, so the verb cannot be separated from the other step handlers.

name: maybe_Ui_ItemScreen_SelectEntry
summary: Item-screen step handler: when the page scroll is finished it chains to the entry handler with the confirm flag 0x10100 set; otherwise it returns the default handler pair from the callback table.
evidence: The 0x10100 flag marks the positive/confirm path of this family (0x001BFB64 and 0x001C0A24 clear it), which supports 'SelectEntry'; still table-only and there is no direct caller.

name: maybe_Ui_ItemScreen_Cancel
summary: Step handler that waits for the text scroll to finish, then tears down the shop/item lists and notifies the screen vtable +0x5C, returning the next callback pair.
evidence: Calls Ui_TextScroll_IsFinished, Shop_SellItem, maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_ResetListsC; no direct callers, so the cancel/back verb stays inferred.

name: maybe_Model_ApplyFaceAndFrameRows
signature: void maybe_Model_ApplyFaceAndFrameRows(void* self, int face, int frame)
summary: Stores one face-table row and one frame-table row into the 0x158-byte face record selected by self+2 of the model's face owner; 0xFF means leave unchanged.

name: Battle_Ui_SpawnBalloonTypeCForSlot

evidence: Same named callees as 0x001F6CAC with member obtained through vtable +0x48(self, slot).
